mapper.sql: id, fund_code, report_date, report_type, stock_code, stock_name, hold_amount, hold_ratio, rank_no, industry, create_time
mapper.select: SELECT h.* FROM stk_fund_holdings h INNER JOIN ( SELECT fund_code, MAX(report_date) AS max_date FROM stk_fund_holdings WHERE fund_code = #{fundCode} GROUP BY fund_code ) latest ON h.fund_code = latest.fund_code AND h.report_date = latest.max_date ORDER BY h.rank_no
SELECT h.*, f.fund_name FROM stk_fund_holdings h LEFT JOIN stk_fund f ON h.fund_code = f.fund_code WHERE h.stock_code = #{stockCode} ORDER BY h.hold_amount DESC LIMIT 20
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stk_fund_holdings (fund_code, report_date, report_type, stock_code, stock_name, hold_amount, hold_ratio, rank_no, industry, create_time) VALUES (#{fundCode}, #{reportDate}, #{reportType}, #{stockCode}, #{stockName}, #{holdAmount}, #{holdRatio}, #{rankNo}, #{industry}, NOW())

INSERT INTO stk_fund_holdings (fund_code, report_date, report_type, stock_code, stock_name, hold_amount, hold_ratio, rank_no, industry, create_time) VALUES
(#{item.fundCode}, #{item.reportDate}, #{item.reportType}, #{item.stockCode}, #{item.stockName}, #{item.holdAmount}, #{item.holdRatio}, #{item.rankNo}, #{item.industry}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM stk_fund_holdings WHERE fund_code = #{fundCode} AND report_date = #{reportDate}
